flags: minor: 'formal' is eliminated outright by 'No rule in the charter'; 'contentious' contradicts decades of price stability; 'fragile' contradicts 'for decades' -- distractors are weak, so difficulty rests almost entirely on knowing 'tacit'.
S030-01.notes: Unwritten (never mentioned in records) yet consistently observed agreement = tacit. Inserting each: formal contradicts no rule/no mention; fragile contradicts decades of stability; contentious contradicts silence and stability.

S030-02.notes: Small size vs. major significance = contrast; 'belied' (gave a false impression of) fits. Reflected/determined imply size matches/causes significance; exaggerated implies significance overstated. Difficulty from vocabulary 'belied'; 'reflected' is a likely trap.

flags: minor: A is a true detail from the first sentence; obvious as detail vs. main idea.
S030-03.notes: Text centers on multigenerational migration: no individual completes the cycle. B and C unsupported. Facts consistent with monarch biology (overwintering generation breeds in southern US; 2-4 later generations move north).

S030-04.notes: Easy-to-get food leads to poorer health because of low protein -> food content matters more than ease of obtaining. A reverses the premise, C is unsupported speculation, D contradicts (low protein). Study is real (Murray et al. 2015, Edmonton coyotes, body condition and mange).

flags: minor: conclusion explicitly says 'relative to each building group's starting level', which strongly cues percentage-based choice D; A (absolute drop) is the intended trap but is undercut by this wording. D is also the only choice that mentions all three treatments.
S030-05.notes: Computed: film 20->6 = 70% drop; UV 40->22 = 18/40 = 45%; netting 10->4 = 60%. D's numbers are exact and show film largest. A supports UV, B/C are not relative comparisons.

flags: minor: research on hand-raised wolves is mixed in the real literature (Hare et al. 2002 found poor wolf performance; Udell et al. 2008 found good performance), but the text attributes the claim to 'other researchers', so it is acceptable.
S030-06.notes: Text 2 says experience shapes the skill more than recognized -> Text 1's inborn-domestication conclusion overlooks developmental contact. A contradicts, B overreaches about chimps, D unsupported.

flags: minor: key is the only choice that mentions the study's result at all and is the longest; distractors B/C/D are each obviously off-goal (B background, C method without result, D explanation).
S030-07.notes: Surprise = many receptor types (12 = 4x humans' 3, computed correctly) yet worse discrimination. Matches Thoen et al. 2014 Science.

flags: minor: 'As a result' has some surface appeal because the otters' return could be read as the cause of the conflict, but the clause after the blank does not follow from urchin decline/kelp regrowth; the positive-then-negative contrast makes 'Even so' clearly best.
minor: sea urchins are not usually called 'shellfish', but 'appetite for shellfish' refers to crabs and clams, so it reads acceptably.
S030-08.notes: Benefit (kelp regrowth) followed by a downside (conflict with fishers) -> concession/contrast 'Even so'.

S030-09.notes: Nonessential appositive 'a fifteenth-century book written in an unknown script' opens with a comma after 'manuscript' and must close with a comma. A leaves it open; B mismatched dash; D semicolon separates subject from verb. Facts accurate (Voynich dated to early 15th c.; WWII-era/20th-c. codebreakers such as Friedman tried).

S030-10.notes: 'that' clause needs a finite verb (rules out C, D); past narrative with action prior to 'noticed' calls for past perfect 'had killed'; 'has killed' is a tense shift. Fleming returned in early Sept 1928 -- accurate.

flags: minor: C is a decent trap (confuses 'more common than once believed' with 'more common today'), but A and B are easily eliminated.
S030-11.notes: Sentence 2 reports the Draupner measurement that contradicted models predicting such waves to be extremely rare. Facts check out: Draupner wave, 1 Jan 1995, ~25.6 m, significant wave height ~12 m, laser sensor.
